comment: Best tool we've ever used. Saves our team 3 hours a day. Please never change the keyboard shortcuts!
Took 3 weeks to get onboarded because documentation is outdated. Nobody told us the legacy API was deprecated until it broke our integration.
Generally happy. Would love better Slack integration and the ability to schedule reports to be emailed weekly.
I am done. Three outages in one month. Our SLA requires 99.9% uptime and you've missed it twice already. We are actively evaluating CloudRival as a replacement.
Really impressed with the recent updates. The new bulk import feature saved me hours this week. Minor issue: date formatting in exports is MM/DD but we need DD/MM for our EU clients.
It works but feels dated. The UI hasn't changed in 2 years and my team finds it clunky compared to newer tools. Not terrible but not exciting.
Cancelled. Your AI features are just ChatGPT wrappers with a markup. Not worth the enterprise price. Moving to OpenSource alternative.
Solid product. Main feedback is that mobile app needs serious work — it's basically unusable for anything beyond checking notifications.
